summary: Labelled Button sizes now own the 44/32/24px heights promised by the component documentation and approved design. Padding plus line-height previously computed to 40/28/20px, leaving every size four pixels short and the small control below the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 target-size floor. Explicit heights make the geometry and hit area invariant while preserving the existing inline padding, label metrics, variants and icon-only sizes.

migration.manual: No API change. Review dense layouts and visual baselines: every labelled Button is four pixels taller. Icon-only Button dimensions are unchanged.
